title: Scenario
description: The frontmatter of scenarios/<context-slug>/<scenario-slug>.md (SPEC-003). No subtypes: the subject's class already distinguishes an invariant example from an end-to-end acceptance case, so a subtype would be a tag. Exactly one subject. The body carries `## Description`.

subject.description: The one anchor: a Domain Model element, a Rule, or a Contract, by full identity.

involves.description: The identities this scenario touches beyond its subject — the references the capability map derives from (SPEC-003 R6).
